problem_restatement.input: V58 exposes BTC long and short at the asset level, but its executable BTC coverage consists of two short-only Hulk routes and one rare hourly downside-sweep long. The current rally produced zero BTC-long intents because the sweep route had no qualifying sweep in every evaluation.
problem_restatement.output: Test one materially different BTC-long mechanism based on persistent issuer-reported IBIT primary-market share creation, using conservative point-in-time availability and unchanged V58 BTC sweep economics.
problem_restatement.stakeholder: Operator seeking meaningful, evidence-bound growth from a live-capital portfolio.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Determine whether persistent IBIT creation onsets provide stable after-cost BTC-long value, adequate cadence, directional specificity, and incremental value beyond the unchanged V58 sweep without changing the live runtime.

hypothesis: Two consecutive increases in iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF shares outstanding may identify persistent primary-market demand that remains informative for a subsequent Hyperliquid BTC long after conservatively delaying the issuer's as-of row to the next calendar day at 12:00 UTC.
claim_boundaries: A shares-outstanding increase is a creation proxy, not proof of the identity, motivation, or exact bitcoin-execution time of the underlying buyer.

Issuer rows have as-of dates but no historical publication timestamps. The frozen next-day availability and additional twenty-four-hour delay are conservative modeling assumptions, not observed dissemination latency.

The project manually inspected the official endpoint, worksheet names, row count, first and latest as-of dates, and several latest technical rows before this preregistration; it did not calculate candidate events inside the frozen partitions, future returns, trades, or PnL.
All BTC price partitions were opened by prior project studies, and many earlier BTC-long families were tested. This mechanism is new to the project, but the result is not a pristine holdout.
A positive bar replay would not establish exact historical BBO, mark ordering, visible-depth capacity, or prospective source latency.

mechanism_novelty.claim: No preexisting project result found before preregistration uses point-in-time official IBIT shares-outstanding creation persistence as a BTC-long entry source.
mechanism_novelty.material_difference: The primary entry information comes from an issuer-reported ETF share-creation state rather than BTC price breakout, downside sweep, funding sign, open interest, cross-asset breadth, cross-venue spot bars, L2 flow, or a transferred HYPE strategy.
mechanism_novelty.falsifier: An exact preexisting source-bound project result with the same issuer data, availability, onset, and economic identity invalidates novelty and must stop result generation until reconciled.

external_primary_references.title: iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF product page
external_primary_references.supported_role: The issuer publishes IBIT shares outstanding and describes the trust as providing bitcoin exposure.
external_primary_references.unsupported_inference: The product page does not claim that changes in shares outstanding predict future BTC returns.

external_primary_references.title: IBIT registration statement
external_primary_references.supported_role: The filing describes continuous basket creation and redemption and the cash creation/redemption process.
external_primary_references.unsupported_inference: The filing does not establish the historical publication time or a tradable predictive edge.

external_primary_references.title: Official BlackRock fund-data workbook endpoint
external_primary_references.supported_role: The response contains a Historical worksheet with As Of, NAV per Share, Ex-Dividends, and Shares Outstanding fields.
external_primary_references.unsupported_inference: Endpoint availability now does not reconstruct historical dissemination timestamps.

explicitly_not_inspected: candidate signal count in any frozen partition
BTC forward returns conditional on IBIT creations

frozen_market_contract.issuer_observation_cadence: irregular United States business-day as-of rows
frozen_market_contract.gap_rule: cancel any delayed entry that crosses an explicit Hyperliquid minute-data gap
frozen_market_contract.missing_issuer_row_rule: use consecutive published issuer observations without fabricating weekend or holiday rows

frozen_signal_contract.shares_change: current issuer shares outstanding minus the immediately prior issuer observation
frozen_signal_contract.primary_condition: two consecutive strictly positive shares-outstanding changes, emitted only on transition into that persistent-creation state
frozen_signal_contract.primary_onset_formula: positive_delta_t and positive_delta_t_minus_1 and not positive_delta_t_minus_2
frozen_signal_contract.first_positive_control: strictly positive shares change whose immediately prior shares change was not positive
frozen_signal_contract.redemption_long_placebo: two consecutive strictly negative shares changes, emitted only on transition into that persistent-redemption state, traded long
frozen_signal_contract.zero_change_semantics: zero is neither creation nor redemption and resets both persistence states
frozen_signal_contract.availability_time: issuer as-of date plus one calendar day at 12:00 UTC
frozen_signal_contract.rearm_semantics: at least one issuer observation must leave the complete persistence state before a later same-state onset

frozen_controls.definition: Enter on the first strictly positive shares-outstanding change following a nonpositive change, with identical availability, execution, sizing, funding, and friction.
frozen_controls.purpose: Test whether requiring persistence adds value beyond a single creation onset.

frozen_controls.definition: Enter long on transition into two consecutive strictly negative shares-outstanding changes, with otherwise identical rules.
frozen_controls.purpose: Challenge directional specificity; a redemption-long placebo that broadly matches the primary weakens the creation-demand mechanism.

frozen_controls.definition: The unchanged V58 liquidity_sweep_long_1h_stop60_target60_v2 entry with the same 60/60/24h economics.
frozen_controls.purpose: Compare the new information source against the active BTC-long route rather than only no action.
Retain the simplest comparator without making performance a trial-abort gate.

corporate_action_integrity.search_limitation: No official split notice was found in targeted issuer and SEC searches; absence from search is not proof that no corporate action occurred.
corporate_action_integrity.detection: Flag adjacent rows when the shares ratio is within two percent of a registered split factor or its reciprocal and the NAV ratio is within twenty percent of the reciprocal factor.
corporate_action_integrity.falsifier: A split-like discontinuity, duplicate as-of date, nonpositive NAV or shares, or unexpected historical schema prevents signal construction.

frozen_friction_contract.funding_cashflow: exact ordered Hyperliquid hourly funding rows applied with side-correct sign
frozen_friction_contract.depth_limitation: bar replay does not claim exact historical BBO, private latency, queue rank, or fill capacity

partition_disclosure: All three BTC price partitions were previously opened by other project studies. The IBIT mechanism and its exact parameters were frozen before its own partition signal counts and returns, but the evidence is retrospective, previously opened, and exposed to project-level multiple testing.

acceptance_and_disposition_contract.trial_abort_policy: Only technical integrity failure aborts publication. Sparse, losing, high-drawdown, or zero-trade outcomes remain reportable results.
acceptance_and_disposition_contract.cadence_requirement_basis: Ten completed trades per roughly ninety-day out-of-development partition is about 3.3 completed opportunities per month and is a declared usefulness criterion rather than a technical abort gate.
acceptance_and_disposition_contract.if_any_support_requirement_fails: reject this exact candidate without threshold, availability, side, or exit retuning
live_proposal_requires_additionally: shared one-BTC-position comparison against the unchanged V58 sweep and both V58 Hulk short routes
prospective post-preregistration issuer-row capture with observed receipt timestamps
exact Hyperliquid decision-to-BBO mark and visible-depth feasibility
separately versioned live-provider parity with fail-closed external-source behavior
fresh growth-sizing, correlation, and stop-wave stress
verified flat and order-free transition boundary

candidate_family_trials: Donchian, squeeze, zero-lag, and generic trend-router longs
low-timeframe L2 Ridge and LightGBM direction
prior_search_accounting.search_count_limitation: The list is an explicit family inventory rather than a statistically complete count of every parameter or diagnostic viewed across the project.

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: IBIT creations may respond to BTC price changes already completed before the issuer row rather than lead subsequent returns.
The next-day noon availability assumption may still precede actual historical publication; the additional twenty-four-hour delay challenges this risk but cannot reconstruct exact timestamps.
Shares outstanding can change for operational or corporate-action reasons that are not directional investor demand.
IBIT is only one United States spot bitcoin product and may not represent aggregate global spot demand.
Daily issuer observations may be too sparse for meaningful portfolio contribution.
The opened historical partitions and extensive prior BTC search create material selection and multiple-testing risk.
One-minute OHLC cannot establish exact intraminute mark ordering, queue position, or depth.
The fixed 60/60 exit isolates entry information but may not be optimal for multi-day institutional demand; it cannot be retuned under this identity.
A positive standalone result may still displace stronger V58 BTC routes in shared capital.
falsifiers: Implementation differs from the exact source, corporate-action, availability, onset, entry, exit, sizing, funding, fee, slippage, delay, or partition contract.
Independent reconstruction changes an issuer row, event identity, trade lifecycle, or aggregate metric.
Any candidate support requirement fails in validation or pseudo-holdout.
The redemption-long placebo broadly matches or exceeds the candidate, weakening directional specificity.
Prospective source-compatible events arrive later than modeled or cannot execute at modeled size and friction.

single_highest_value_next_action.action: Acquire and checksum-bind the exact official BlackRock response into a new immutable report-only bundle, parse and validate the Historical worksheet without calculating candidate events or returns, then bind all source hashes before the one allowed replay.
